name: Abha Power and Steel Ltd
about: Founded in 2004, Abha Power and Steel Limited is engaged in the business of casting and manufacturing iron and steel products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Abha Power and Steel Limited operates in the iron and steel foundry business, producing standard and customized products for industries like Indian Railways, steel, cement, mining, power, and heavy engineering. 
Its manufacturing expertise spans all grades of mild steel, spheroidal graphite iron, manganese steel, stainless steel, and high alloy castings. The company is certified by RDSO for supplying casting products to Indian Railways and holds a PED certificate, qualifying it for exports to European nations

pros: Stock is trading at 1.11 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
